entry.title: googleapis/google-cloud-dotnet - Releases - 2025-12-09
entry.content:
Google.Cloud.Maintenance.Api.V1 version 1.0.0-beta01

New features

  • Initial generation for Google.Cloud.Maintenance.Api.V1

Google.Cloud.Firestore version 4.1.0

New features

  • Publish the pipelines API to the stable branch

Documentation improvements

  • Minor api documentation changes

Google.Cloud.Run.V2 version 2.18.0

New features

  • Add SourceCode proto to Run container config

Documentation improvements

  • A comment for field etag in message .google.cloud.run.v2.Job is changed
  • A comment for field limits in message .google.cloud.run.v2.ResourceRequirements is changed
  • A comment for field items in message .google.cloud.run.v2.SecretVolumeSource is changed
  • A comment for field name in message .google.cloud.run.v2.Service is changed
  • A comment for field invoker_iam_disabled in message .google.cloud.run.v2.Service is changed
  • A comment for field etag in message .google.cloud.run.v2.Service is changed
  • A comment for field observed_generation in message .google.cloud.run.v2.WorkerPool is changed
  • A comment for field latest_ready_revision in message .google.cloud.run.v2.WorkerPool is changed
  • A comment for field custom_audiences in message .google.cloud.run.v2.WorkerPool is changed
  • A comment for field reconciling in message .google.cloud.run.v2.WorkerPool is changed
  • A comment for field etag in message .google.cloud.run.v2.WorkerPool is changed

Google.Cloud.GkeMultiCloud.V1 version 2.10.0

New features

  • Added custom tolerations and labels support for Attached Clusters
  • Mark GKE-on-AWS and GKE-on-Azure protos as being deprecated to discourage any new usage as these services turn down

Documentation improvements

  • A comment for field tags in message .google.cloud.gkemulticloud.v1.AttachedCluster is changed
  • A comment for field throughput in message .google.cloud.gkemulticloud.v1.AwsVolumeTemplate is changed
  • A comment for field requested_cancellation in message .google.cloud.gkemulticloud.v1.OperationMetadata is changed

Google.Cloud.Compute.V1 version 3.20.0

New features

  • Update Compute Engine v1 API to revision 20251031

Google.Cloud.AIPlatform.V1 version 3.58.0

Bug fixes

  • Fix issue when using UrlContext tool

Google.Cloud.AIPlatform.V1Beta1 version 1.0.0-beta63

Bug fixes

  • Fix issue when using UrlContext tool
